notablePrerequisites: Swift Reconfiguration attached to Barrenton Medic.
description:
Whenever damage would be dealt to you or a permanent you control, activate Barrenton Medic's first ability by tapping it, preventing the next 1 damage dealt to that target.
Activate Barrenton Medic's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat as necessary.
